title: Functorial exact stage Hom rows before colimit exactness
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram and c a colimit cocone with IsColimit witness. Fix i∈I, a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], and s₀:X→Spec(R_i), locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of modules on every scheme exist in the fixed universe w. Let U,V be opens of X with U compact and V affine. Let t:Y→X be an open immersion with range U∪V, and s:Y→Spec(R_i) equal to t≫s₀, locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the localized module-site derived categories on every open of Y exist in universe w. Fix perfect P,Q in D(O_Y) [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then there exist an exact five-term row S in the category of tail-indexed abelian-group diagrams, an exact five-term row B of abelian groups at the limit, and a row morphism κ from S to the constant diagram on B. The middle diagram S₂ has equivalences e_j to Hom(P_j,Q_j) identifying its transitions with perfectStageMap, and B₂ has an equivalence b to Hom(P_limit,Q_limit) identifying κ₂,j with perfectLimitMap. For r=0,1,3,4 the induced map colim(S_r)→B_r has PerfectHomLocalMap(U,V,-). No exactness of the colimit row and no supplied set Hom system is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the stage and limit complexes, their central pinning equations, their distinguished-triangle presentations, and their four local comparisons by the geometric construction lemma.
Apply the categorical Hom-triangle exactness theorem to the supplied presentations, then combine the resulting exactness witnesses with the geometric data.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09RE, geometric construction followed by categorical exactness
proof_origin.note: The target exactness proof is complete; the geometric construction remains a separate, explicitly triangle-presented obligation.

theorem perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_stage_rows
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : t.opensRange = U ⊔ V)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q)
    : ∃ (S : ComposableArrows (Set.Ici i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u w}) 4)
        (B : ComposableArrows AddCommGrpCat.{max u w} 4)
        (κ : S ⟶ B ⋙ Functor.const (Set.Ici i))
        (e : ∀ j : Set.Ici i, (S.obj' 2).obj j ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q))
        (b : B.obj' 2 ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)),
        S.Exact ∧ B.Exact ∧
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (f : (S.obj' 2).obj j),
          e k ((S.obj' 2).map (homOfLE hjk) f) =
            perfectStageMap R s j.property hjk (e j f)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (f : (S.obj' 2).obj j),
          b ((κ.app ⟨2, by decide⟩).app j f) =
            perfectLimitMap R c s j.property (e j f)) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 0) ⟨B.obj' 0, κ.app ⟨0, by decide⟩⟩) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 1) ⟨B.obj' 1, κ.app ⟨1, by decide⟩⟩) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 3) ⟨B.obj' 3, κ.app ⟨3, by decide⟩⟩) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 4) ⟨B.obj' 4, κ.app ⟨4, by decide⟩⟩)
